anchorUnits: cell pixels, continuous, x right / y down, 0 = cell top-left edge; tiles from the sim point: ((x - origin.x) / pxPerTile, (origin.y - y) / pxPerTile)

atlas.filter: authored at 1 texel = 1 px at this density; sample NEAREST for crisp pixels

mirror: facing -1: flip the cell horizontally about origin x (anchor x' = 2*origin.x - x)
originMeaning: pixel-edge coords of the sim row point: RIG feet centre (player.x, player.y)
